Practice
To practice with the testing calculators, you can also visit our Test Practice Page or learn more about using Desmos on in-class assessments in our Help Center.
Accessibility
Desmos Studio PBC is committed to building accessible products. Review our WCAG 2.2 compliance reports and more information about our features on our Accessibility page.
Privacy
Desmos does not receive any student data from assessments. Learn more about our privacy and data policies.
Contact Us
Reach out to us at assessments@desmos.com if you have questions or feedback, or if you'd like to see Desmos calculators on your assessment.
